comment: Build bootstrap lock. macOS sections pin the Apple toolchain; linux sections pin the Alpine musl toolchain. doctor verifies the section matching the requested target family.

cpu_baseline.deployment_provenance: product policy macOS 26+ only, owner direction 2026-10-26 (upstream minimum 13.5)

linux_baseline.cflag_provenance: x86-64-v2 microarchitecture baseline (SSE4.2/AVX); portable across modern x86_64, matches Enterprise Linux 9 family floor
linux_baseline.deployment_provenance: minimum musl libc version supported at runtime; Alpine 3.25 ships 1.2.6

linux_toolchain.kind: native Alpine musl toolchain (gcc + musl libc), no LLVM archive
linux_toolchain.provenance: observed via gcc -dumpversion, clang --version, ldd --version: Alpine build host 2026-10-26 (clang 23.1.3) and CI Alpine container 2026-10-27 (clang 23.1.4-r0, image alpine@sha256:266f29255458134745f2bf588cb23ed1ed1768b96ff2580a05d70a8aba59e145); edge dropped 23.1.3-r0, pin follows the qualification environment

toolchain.kind: native Apple Xcode toolchain, no LLVM archive
toolchain.provenance: observed on build host 2026-10-26 via xcodebuild, xcrun, clang --version
